name: gout-policy-governed-structured-request-fields
instr:
gout lacks a coherent policy for duplicate, empty, rejected, and redacted structured fields across query parameters, headers, multipart forms, and URL-encoded forms. Add ordered field decisions and atomic pre-transport validation, preserving existing behavior when no policy is selected.

`FieldPolicy` must govern `QueryEncode`, `HeaderEncode`, `FormEncode`, and `WWWFormEncode` without changing destination-specific escaping, canonicalization, raw spelling, multipart, or URL-form semantics. `EmptyMode` must preserve, skip, or reject values according to existing reflection and conversion behavior. Accumulation, replacement, rejection, preservation, and skipping must match ordered `FieldEmitted`, `FieldSkipped`, `FieldReplaced`, `FieldRedacted`, and `FieldRejected` outcomes and final wire data.

`FailureAtomic` returns the field error and no request before transport, with no partial multipart bytes. `FailurePartial` retains accepted fields and reports rejected attempts. `FieldReport` describes the latest construction attempt, survives failure, matches finalized wire data, and clears with each new request lifecycle.

In `github.com/guonaihong/gout/dataflow`, provide pointer-receiver APIs `WithFieldPolicy(policy encode.FieldPolicy) *DataFlow`, `FieldReport() encode.FieldReport`, and `Debug(debug bool) *DataFlow`. In `github.com/guonaihong/gout`, provide `WithFieldPolicy(policy encode.FieldPolicy) Option` for every `NewWithOpt` client verb flow. Keep request overrides isolated. Poli
